observation: Round 1 (detection-only Hough relaxation) moved the proxy 0.5435 -> 0.5774 and correspondence_f1@15 0.213 -> 0.275, with ring_count_error still 0, recentre residual still 2 cm and depth_nan_ratio unchanged at 20.9% (family-normal), so stages 1-3 remain healthy and the gain is attributable to detection. sam_fill_rate did not move at all (0.7318 identical), i.e. the SAM stage output is still governed by the same coverage, and the remaining deficit is in line/boundary agreement. The refreshed round-1 artifacts still show only ~13 oblique segments (red/green) over 10 rings and initial_prompt_points.png still has 4 'assume' centres out of 10 (rings at x~180, 2160, 2520, 3240; det_real_detection_ratio stays 0.6). In the binarised outlier map the circumferential joints are essentially invisible: the map is dominated by the grid of V-shaped bolt-hole marks, so the surviving oblique lines fit through bolt-hole rows flanking a joint rather than the joint itself. Where two such lines bracket a K block (e.g. ring x~2520: y~1480 and y~1780; ring x~2160: y~3480 and y~3760) their spacing is ~280-300 px, not the 245 px K_height prior, so the distance-pattern check rejects them at tolerance 12 and the ring falls back to 'assume'. sam_segment_size_cv 1.09 is consistent with those assumed centres landing off the true block rows.
rule: Ontology d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) -> stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines, combined with d8 (m_spacing_regularity poor vs K/AB pattern) -> f_pattern_mismatch; inter-stage chain f_pattern_mismatch -> stage_5 f_crop_offset. Remediation r_relax_hough (lower oblique threshold / raise maxLineGap toward the tunnel prior) with its precondition satisfied (no upstream f_depth_holes: NaN family-normal; f_joint_oversmoothed is present but its remediation r_lower_depth_threshold is outside the tunable bounds, so the closest in-bounds proxy is a lower binarisation threshold), plus r_fix_height_priors via a larger pattern_tolerance. Experiences section 7 ordering: stages 1-3 validated, detection is the active stage; SAM geometry (segment_width/K_height/angle) stays at tunnel priors because det_real_detection_ratio is still 0.6 and section 4 warns geometry knobs are load-bearing for transfer.
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines + f_pattern_mismatch (bolt-row-fitted oblique lines bracket K blocks at ~280-300 px, rejected at tolerance 12; 40% of rings still on 'assume' fallback), propagating to stage_5 f_crop_offset.
rationale: Take a second, moderate step along the direction that paid off in round 1 and add the missing pattern-tolerance lever. binary_threshold 110 -> 100 (bound) so the faintest joint outlier pixels survive binarisation and dilation, the only in-bounds substitute for lowering the stage-3 depth thresholds. hough_threshold_oblique 35 -> 30 and maxLineGap_oblique 65 -> 75 so dotted joint / bolt-row evidence within [5,10] deg accumulates into full-width segments on the four rings that still fall back (minLineLength is fixed, which caps spurious short lines). pattern_tolerance 12 -> 15 so K-bracketing intersections that miss the 245 px prior by a few tens of pixels are accepted as real centres instead of dropped to 'assume'; kept below the 20 px bound to limit false matches while more lines are present. Horizontal fallback gates (40 / 15) are kept at their round-1 values: fallback should not be made easier while the goal is to reduce it. hough_threshold_vertical left at prior (ring count already exact). Denoising, enhancing and SAM untouched so the round-2 delta remains attributable to detection; if det_real_detection_ratio rises and sam_segment_size_cv stays >1, round 3 can revisit SAM template geometry, otherwise round 3 backs off toward the round-1 settings.
